leftEvidence.role: The Father who sees in secret
leftEvidence.title: Fasting is hidden from the public gaze

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Jesus warns against altering appearance so people notice a fast.
points.right: Jesus warns against doing merciful deeds before people in order to be seen.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Ordinary appearance hides the fast from people while the Father sees and rewards.
points.right: Public reward is contrasted with hidden giving and the Father who sees in secret.

payload.posture: Giving and fasting repeat the seen-by-people and seen-by-Father contrast.

rightEvidence.role: The Father who sees in secret
rightEvidence.title: Giving is tested by its audience

payload.tension: Their actions differ, and neither passage supplies a universal schedule for the practice.
payload.title: Hidden devotion and received reward
